form:FormGroup.label: Function Name
form:FormGroup.helpText: The name of the JavaScript constructor that creates the visualisation, for example visualisations.BarChart. It must be defined by the selected script.

form:FormGroup.label: Script
form:FormGroup.helpText: The script document that defines the visualisation's function. Scripts it depends on are loaded first.

form:FormGroup.label: Settings
form:FormGroup.helpText: JSON that defines the options users can set for this visualisation in a dashboard, grouped into tabs.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: JSON defining the dashboard options, grouped into tabs.
